limitations: Only three methods are decoded: axes through two construction planes, three-plane intersection points, and sketch-point reference points.
Stored method/feature codes are accepted only in the observed typed class/layout combinations.

Method names and ordered support roles are grounded in controlled generator invocations, owned native reference tables and local SDK definitions; the older fixtures did not capture API definition getters directly.
Geometry is read from checked native caches and compared with explicit supports; general construction regeneration is not implemented.
Axis direction sign and anchor point are retained from the cached native line; an arbitrary canonical intersection line is not substituted.
General backend auxiliary fields, assembly occurrence context, face/edge/vertex construction supports and other methods remain unsupported.
No new Fusion captures, UI access, shared file edits or native file writing were used for this stage.
